```{r}
df_mfdr_summary <- bind_rows(df_mfdr_95p_spike, df_mfdr_95p_spike1, df_mfdr_95p_spike2, df_lrp_95p_spike,df_lime_95p_spike, df_shap_95p_spike, df_rand_95p_spike)
df_mfdr_summary <- df_mfdr_summary %>%
  group_by(method)%>%
  summarize (
    mean_recall = mean(recall),
    recall_90p = quantile(recall, probs = 0.9),
    recall_75p = quantile(recall, probs = 0.75),
    recall_50p = quantile(recall, probs = 0.5),
    recall_25p = quantile(recall, probs = 0.25),
    recall_0p = quantile(recall, probs = 0)
  ) 

df_mfdr_summary
```


```{r}
df_mfdr_summary <- bind_rows(df_mfdr_95p_spike, df_lrp_95p_spike, df_lime_95p_spike)
df_mfdr_summary <- df_mfdr_summary %>%
  group_by(method)%>%
  summarize (
    mean_fdr = mean(false.discovery.rate),
    fdr_90p = quantile(false.discovery.rate, probs = 0.9),
    fdr_50p = quantile(false.discovery.rate, probs = 0.5),
    fdr_10p = quantile(false.discovery.rate, probs = 0.1),
    fdr_0p = quantile(false.discovery.rate, probs = 0)
  )

df_mfdr_summary
```
